# Invitation to Autoliv’s Q1, 2026 Earnings Call


Thu, Mar 26, 2026 14:00 CET[Report this content](https://news.cision.com/_editorial/Contact?url=https%3a%2f%2fnews.cision.com%2fautoliv%2fr%2finvitation-to-autoliv-s-q1--2026-earnings-call%2cc4325728)


***(Stockholm, Sweden, March 26, 2026)*** **– Autoliv Inc., plans to publish its Financial Report**


**for the first quarter 2026 on Friday, April 17, 2026 at 12:00 Central European Time (CET).**


The report will be available at


[www.autoliv.com](http://www.autoliv.com/)


In addition, a teleconference will take place the same day


.


**Q1 2026 Earnings Call:**


**Date:**


April 17, 2026


**Time:**


14:00 – 15:00 CET


**Main speaker:**


Mikael Bratt, President & CEO


**To attend by webcast** , please use the link on our web or the link below:


[https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/bsxkr7js](https://edge.media-server.com/mmc/p/bsxkr7js)


**To attend by phone** , use the link below to register your participation and obtain your personal pin code and phone number:


[https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI09fb807e511c46a68a96e6143ca4d3e4](https://register-conf.media-server.com/register/BI09fb807e511c46a68a96e6143ca4d3e4)


**Audio replay** will be available after the conference until April 17, 2027:


[www.autoliv.com/investors/reports-presentations-transcripts](http://www.autoliv.com/investors/reports-presentations-transcripts)


**Transcript** will be available on:


[www.autoliv.com/investors/reports-presentations-transcripts](http://www.autoliv.com/investors/reports-presentations-transcripts%0d)


For more information about Autoliv, please visit


[www.autoliv.com](http://www.autoliv.com/)


Best regards


,


**Anders Trapp**


V.P. Investor Relations

anders.trapp@autoliv.com
